## What's new in 1.0.0

First stable release of **Optique** — a modern gallery app built with Jetpack Compose.

- **Brand-new launcher icon** — the app ships with the official Optique icon everywhere; legacy Gallery icon variants are gone
- **Fresh README, release signing, and shipping pipeline**

> **Note:** Version code resets to 10000. If you installed an older Optique build, uninstall it before updating.
